description: Summary figure: pocket geometry, dN/dS by site class, per-species comparison, conservation profile
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT="/agent/jobs/ad7edfe9-b6a6-4270-b5cb-6f473ffd667f/provenance"
pm=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/patch_mapping.csv")
R=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/dnds_by_site_class.csv")
E=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/ALLC_dnds_per_species.csv")
MAMM={"Boreoeutheria","Euarchontoglires","Catarrhini","Primates","Eutheria","Theria","Mammalia","Simiiformes","Hominidae","Hominoidea","Homininae","Haplorrhini"}
D=E[E.taxlevel.isin(MAMM)&(E.type=="ortholog_one2one")&(E.dS_all>0.15)].dropna(subset=["w_patch","w_rest"])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,10))

ax=axes[0,0]
x=np.arange(len(pm))
cols=["#2d6a4f" if s else "#c1121f" for s in pm.same]
ax.bar(x, pm.dSC, color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{a}/{b}" for a,b in zip(pm.yeast,pm.human)], rotation=90, fontsize=6)
ax.axhline(1.0, ls="--", c="grey", lw=.8)
ax.set_ylabel("side-chain centroid deviation (A)")
ax.set_title("Conserved allantoicase pocket residues:\nyeast 1SG3 vs human ALLC AlphaFold model (per-domain fit)", fontsize=10)
ax.text(.02,.93,"green = identical to yeast (40/42)\nred = substituted in human (T102V, N108D)",transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=8)

ax=axes[0,1]
order=["patch_exposed","other_exposed","patch_buried","other_buried","all"]
lab={"patch_exposed":"pocket, exposed\n(n=12)","other_exposed":"non-pocket, exposed\n(n=192)",
     "patch_buried":"pocket, buried\n(n=24)","other_buried":"non-pocket, buried\n(n=117)","all":"whole protein\n(n=391)"}
vals=[R.set_index("set").loc[o,"w"] for o in order]
ax.bar(range(5), vals, color=["#1d3557","#a8dadc","#457b9d","#cfd8dc","#6c757d"])
ax.set_xticks(range(5)); ax.set_xticklabels([lab[o] for o in order], fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("dN/dS (pooled, 84 mammalian orthologs)")
ax.set_title("Purifying selection on the ALLC pocket in mammals", fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+0.004,f"{v:.3f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)

ax=axes[1,0]
ax.scatter(D.w_rest, D.w_patch, s=22, c="#1d3557", alpha=.8)
lim=max(D.w_rest.max(),D.w_patch.max())*1.05
ax.plot([0,lim],[0,lim],ls="--",c="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("dN/dS, rest of protein"); ax.set_ylabel("dN/dS, pocket residues")
ax.set_title("Per-species human-vs-mammal comparison (n=%d)\npaired Wilcoxon p=1.1e-12"%len(D), fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1,1]
cons=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/conservation_by_yeast_position.csv")
ax.plot(cons.yeast_pos, cons.act_cons.rolling(9,center=True,min_periods=1).mean(), label="12 active allantoicases", c="#2d6a4f")
ax.plot(cons.yeast_pos, cons.mam_cons.rolling(9,center=True,min_periods=1).mean(), label="5 mammalian ALLC", c="#c1121f")
inv=cons[cons.act_cons==1.0]
ax.scatter(inv.yeast_pos, np.full(len(inv),1.03), marker="|", c="k", s=40, label="invariant positions (n=51)")
ax.set_xlabel("yeast allantoicase (P25335) position"); ax.set_ylabel("identity to yeast (9-residue mean)")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right"); ax.set_ylim(0,1.12)
ax.set_title("Sequence conservation along the two jelly-roll repeats", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
